finding.text: Most of the read-aloud asks in requirements.md are not in this diff: the voice choice, speed and a Sample button in the dictation settings; "switch your voice" by voice command; the echo guard so the mic stops transcribing the read-aloud (the owner heard "Here is a reply. Read aloud." several times); `voice-models.md` (`voice-models/` holds only its requirements.md); the measured Kokoro RAM and CPU answer; Chatterbox-Turbo; and Servex running one voice engine at a time with an idle shutdown. plan.md "Queued" lists most of them, but the echo guard, voice sampling and the voice command are in no queue item, so they would be lost.

findings.md §3 "What changed" still says "(Filled in as the build lands.)". The brief asks for findings.md "with the V3 trail and what changed", and a fresh agent can't tell what landed on worktree/dictation-v3 without it (7 commits, 0520ee2ad…113cdb730).

`ChatV3.wire()` (ext/Chat/v3/ChatV3.js, the `/^v-|^[w-]{6,}$/` test): `[w-]` matches only the letter "w" and "-", so the live reply stream only reaches sessions whose id starts with `v-`. Any other id (a uuid, a typed session) gets no streaming. It looks like a typo for `[\w-]`.

Servex/agents/session-smart.md:60 still says "the fast assistant waits about 8 seconds for you and stays quiet if you answered first". With the fast seat off by default this is stale; the paragraph edited at line 16 of the diff fixed the principle but missed this one.

The Question that `Sessions.say()` files for a "?" sentence uses `"q-" + Date.now()` (Servex/agents/Sessions.js:1027). Two "?" sentences in the same millisecond, such as a batch replay, would get the same id; `PromptLines.prompt_id()` already exists for minting ids.

`shots/chat-v3-real-400.png` still shows the link icon on every card, so it was taken before 113cdb730 removed it. No shot shows the new `Chat V1 ▾` version dropdown, and the shots sit loose in `shots/` instead of `shots/<page>/` with a layout.json, so this review could not answer the page systems from them.

`ReciteHighlight` is a new class with pure, testable statics (`word_at`, `words`), but Recite.test.mjs gains no check for it, and no page shows its live instance. A two-line `word_at` check would be cheap.

ux/Dictate/doc/fast-and-smart.md now opens with "Now: the fast seat is off by default", but its next line still reads "Status: design … Nothing here is built". A reader gets two statuses one line apart; give it one.

Simpler path, checked: V3 reading `{chat}` read-only (plan decision 1) is the cheapest way to show 100% of replies with no Servex restart, and the fast-seat switch is a three-word enum with a code fallback for Questions. Both are sound.

The smart seat's own role prompt is now wrong: `Servex/agents/session-smart.md:19` still tells it "there is usually no fast assistant (it is off by default; code ... files a Question for each "?")", so the live smart seat will act as the only voice while the voice assistant is placing sentences beside it. Reword it to "the fast assistant (the voice assistant) places and refines each sentence; you are the voice that answers", and soften line 76's "When it is switched on".

`dictation-v3/findings.md:44` still says "The fast seat is off by default; code files a Question for each "?" sentence", and §2 still argues for the pause. A fresh agent who reads this task folder alone will think the pause stands. Add a line to §2: the owner reversed it on 2026-11-01 (session.jsonl Prompt `qrct21sx`, "turning it off isn't going to fix anything"), commit 8a99d651c.

`public/framework/ux/Dictate/Widget.css:254`: the comment says "With the fast seat off by default nothing settles". With the seat back on, lines settle again, so check whether the dropped 0.6 fade should come back, and fix the comment either way.

`ux/Dictate/doc/fast-and-smart.md:3` states it as fact that the seat "does half of the work, placement and refinement". The owner said it "might be". Quote the owner's words and link Prompt `qrct21sx` rather than paraphrase.

Checked and sound: the default flips in one place (`Sessions.js` `session_assistant()`); code files a Question only when `fast_off()` (`Sessions.js:1058`), so the seat and code never both file one; `node agents/Sessions.test.mjs` passes 28 checks in the `fast-seat-voice` worktree. It takes effect at the next Servex restart, which must not happen during a voice call.

The heal never fires for a phone that already has the page cached: `stale_cache()` only acts on a 200 (Server/SiteGateway.mjs:68), but the site answers a repeat page load with a 304, because express.static and compress.js both send an ETag and `no-cache` (Server/Server.js:43, Server/compress.js:92). The phone revalidates the HTML, gets a 304, and keeps its stale `Sheet.js`. The simplest fix: for a document request from a browser that hasn't been cleared yet, drop `If-None-Match` and `If-Modified-Since` in `headers()` (Server/SiteGateway.mjs:103) so the site sends a 200.

The test can't catch finding 1: its fake site never sends an ETag and always answers 200 (Server/SiteGateway.cache.test.mjs:15). Step 3 needs a site that answers a matching `If-None-Match` with a 304, the way the real site does.

The task folder doesn't record this work: findings.md doesn't mention the gateway cache fix, there is no sub-task folder or session.jsonl line for it, and the commit sits only on `worktree/gateway-cache` (b2d5ab853). A fresh agent reading dictation-v3/ alone wouldn't know it exists or that it serves priority 1 (read-aloud over monorepo.lew42.com, the phone's old `Sheet.js`). Add a line to findings.md §3 under "On a worktree".

`h["cache-control"] ??= "no-cache"` (Server/SiteGateway.mjs:136) mostly does nothing for static files, because Server.js has sent `no-cache` since 2026-10-05. It still covers the fallback routes, so it is harmless. The doc line in tunnel.md:44 could say that the old replies predate that change.

Chrome is known to stall the page load for a moment while it handles `Clear-Site-Data: "cache"`. It happens once per browser per `CACHE_V`, so it is acceptable, but the doc should say so, so a slow first load on the phone isn't mistaken for a new bug.
